crop_stage_rules.activity: Nursery bed preparation; seed treatment with Trichoderma 5 g/kg; apply silver plastic mulch on main beds; thin overcrowded seedlings at 12 DAS.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: FYM 25 t/ha basal; 19:19:19 @ 2 g/L foliar spray at 18 DAS to establish root mass.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Light daily rose-can watering on nursery beds; maintain moderate but even moisture.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harden seedlings 4 days before transplanting by reducing water and exposing to outdoor conditions.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Transplant to main field at 45×60 cm; install bamboo stakes and jute twine; first hand-weeding; remove lower soil-contact leaves.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Basal DAP 50 kg/ha + Urea 25 kg/ha top dress; Magnesium Sulphate 2 g/L foliar at 35 DAS.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip every 2–3 days; target 25–30 mm/week; avoid wetting foliage.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Remove all side suckers below the first fruit-set truss to maintain single/double-stem vertical structure.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Install Helicoverpa pheromone traps; shake trusses gently at 10:00–12:00 to assist pollination; spray Boron 1 g/L to improve fruit set.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: 13:0:45 (Potassium Nitrate) 3 g/L + Calcium Nitrate 2 g/L foliar; Boron 1 g/L.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Critical: consistent uniform moisture every 2 days to prevent Blossom End Rot (BER).
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: NEVER allow soil to dry completely then irrigate heavily – causes fruit cracking and BER.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Support heavy fruit trusses with strings; remove bottom yellowed/diseased leaves; harvest at breaker stage for long-distance markets, ripe stage for local.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: 0:0:50 (SOP) 4 g/L to enhance fruit colour, firmness and sugar; stop fertigation 10 days pre-final harvest.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Maintain moderate uniform moisture; reduce water 3 days before peak picking to improve shelf life.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest in early morning; cool in shade immediately; never mix diseased and healthy fruits in same crate.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Plant certified cut tubers treated with Mancozeb 2 g/kg; form furrow ridges 60×20 cm; pre-emergence weed control with Pendimethalin.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Basal: 12:32:16 NPK @ 150 kg/ha + Zinc Sulphate 25 kg/ha + FYM 25 t/ha.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Pre-sowing irrigation to bring soil to field capacity; light irrigation at 5 DAS if soil dry.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Check 15 DAS for uniform emergence; gap-fill missing plants with sprouted reserve tubers immediately.

crop_stage_rules.activity: First earthing-up at 30 DAS to cover developing stolons; first hand / chemical weeding; hilling to protect tubers from sunlight greening.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Top dress Urea 50 kg/ha just before earthing up; Neem Cake 200 kg/ha around root zone.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Furrow irrigation every 7–10 days; avoid water topping over ridges.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Well-formed ridges insulate developing tubers and prevent green-skin problem (solanine toxicity).

crop_stage_rules.activity: Monitor foliage closely for early/late blight (concentric rings or water-soaked lesions); spray preventive Mancozeb at first sign.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Potassium Sulphate (0:0:50) @ 5 g/L + Boron 1 g/L foliar spray to maximise tuber size and quality.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: MOST CRITICAL STAGE: Irrigate every 5–7 days; uniform consistent moisture maximises tuber bulk.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Never allow soil around bulking tubers to become bone-dry; drought stress now causes malformed tubers.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Dehaulm (cut top foliage) 10–12 days before harvest to harden potato skin for storage; monitor for volunteer regrowth.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: No fertilizer application; any late nitrogen causes soft tubers prone to bacterial rot.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Completely withhold irrigation 10 days before harvest to dry soil for mechanical lifting.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest with potato digger; avoid mechanical skinning; cure tubers 7 days at 15°C before cold storage.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Sow at 60×20 cm; treat seed with Azospirillum + PSB biofertilizer; apply pre-emergence weedicide (Atrazine 1.5 kg a.i./ha).
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Basal: 10:26:26 @ 100 kg/ha + Zinc Sulphate 25 kg/ha at sowing.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Pre-sowing irrigation; light irrigation at 5–7 DAS; avoid heavy watering at emergence.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Thin to one healthy plant per hill at 12 DAS if multiple germinated; retain tallest seedling.

crop_stage_rules.activity: First inter-cultivation weeding at 25 DAS; earthing up; scout leaf whorls for Fall Armyworm (FAW) frass and feeding holes.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: First Urea top-dress 50 kg/ha around root zone; incorporate before earthing up.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Irrigate at 25–30 DAS; ensure no waterlogging in root zone.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Apply Emamectin Benzoate 0.4 g/L into leaf whorls if FAW larvae (green caterpillars) found.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Monitor silk emergence; pollen shed visible; avoid all chemical sprays in 10:00–14:00 window when bees actively pollinate silks.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Second Urea 35 kg/ha top-dress + 13:0:45 foliar 3 g/L to maximise grain number.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: MOST CRITICAL STAGE: Moisture stress now = barren ears and severe yield loss. Irrigate every 4–6 days.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Any drought stress at this stage is IRREVERSIBLE – prioritise corn irrigation over other crops if water is limited.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Monitor cob husk for drying; erect bird-scaring devices; harvest when a hard black layer forms at grain base (milk-line disappears).
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: No fertilizer; excessive N at grain fill causes lodging.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Terminal irrigation at dough stage only; withhold 10 days before harvest.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Shell cobs and dry grain to <12% moisture before storage to prevent aflatoxin contamination.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Prepare nursery pro-trays; sow single seed/cell; transplant 4–6 leaf seedling onto silver-black mulch beds with drip tape.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Pro-tray media: cocopeat 50% + perlite 25% + vermicompost 25%; 19:19:19 @ 1 g/L fortnightly in nursery.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Micro-mist nursery 2–3 times daily; daily drip 1 hour after transplanting to establish roots.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Remove crown flower bud (first central bud) at transplanting to push lateral branching.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Tie lateral branches to Y-support string; inspect for thrips and broad mites using 10× hand lens weekly.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Fertigation: 19:19:19 @ 3 kg/acre weekly + MgSO4 2 g/L + Zinc 0.5 g/L foliar fortnightly.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip 1.5–2 hours daily in summer; 1 hour in cooler weather; target 20–25 mm/week.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Maintain plant at 2-stem Y-structure; remove all stems below first fork. Install sticky yellow traps for whitefly/thrips monitoring.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Begin harvesting green fruits once full size reached; harvest every 7–10 days; leave 1 cm pedicel attached.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Alternate weekly: Week A = Calcium Nitrate 3 g/L + 13:0:45 3 g/L; Week B = 0:0:50 4 g/L + Boron 1 g/L.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Consistent drip daily; any moisture stress causes bitter/malformed fruits and Blossom End Rot.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest before colour change for green pepper; allow to fully colour (red/yellow) for coloured premium grades.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Treat seed with Rhizobium + PSB inoculant slurry 2 hours before sowing; sow at 45×5 cm; apply Pendimethalin pre-emergence.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Basal: SSP (Single Super Phosphate) 150 kg/ha at sowing; no Nitrogen – Rhizobium fixes all N required.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Monsoon rainfed; if rainfall delayed past 10 DAS, provide single light protective irrigation.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Check root nodule colour at 21 DAS: pink/red nodules = active N-fixation; white nodules = re-inoculate.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Hand/mechanical weeding at 20 DAS; intercultivation with bullock-drawn blade harrow; scout for semi-looper and soybean leaf folder.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Foliar spray 2% DAP (Diammonium Phosphate) solution at 30 DAS if nodulation weak; MgSO4 1 g/L.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Rainfed; provide supplemental irrigation only if no rainfall >10 days.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Perform hoeing at 20 DAS to loosen soil for maximum nodule aeration and root activity.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Scout intensely for pod borer (Maruca vitrata) and soybean rust; spray Chlorantraniliprole for borer, Hexaconazole for rust.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: 0:52:34 (MKP) @ 5 g/L foliar at pod initiation; Sulphur 0.5 g/L for oil quality.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Provide 1 supplemental irrigation at pod fill if monsoon has withdrawn; critical for final seed weight.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: DO NOT apply any insecticide during open flower stages; wait for late afternoon when pollinators are less active.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Harvest when 95% of pods turn brown; leaves yellow and shed; use combine or manual sickle cutting.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: No fertilizer required.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: No irrigation; dry conditions ensure easy threshing and reduced mycotoxin risk.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Dry harvested material to <12% grain moisture; store in moisture-proof bins with fumigant sachets.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Prepare raised beds 30 cm high × 60 cm wide; apply black plastic mulch; transplant runners from certified mother plants; install drip tape under mulch.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Basal: FYM 40 t/ha + SSP 300 kg/ha + MOP 150 kg/ha; 12:61:0 (MAP) @ 2 kg/acre via fertigation at 15 DAS.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Critical first 7 days: drip 2–3 times daily for 30 minutes to establish roots; reduce to twice daily from 7 DAS.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Remove all runner stolons for the first 30 days to direct energy to crown and root development.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Remove dead leaves; scout for two-spotted spider mite (check leaf undersides); apply Abamectin if >3 mites per leaf.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Fertigation: 19:19:19 @ 3 kg/acre weekly + Calcium Nitrate 2 kg/acre weekly; Boron 1 g/L monthly.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip 2 hours daily morning; maintain root zone at 60–70% field capacity.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Install bird nets and slug-bait pellets before first flower emergence to protect fruits.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Hand-pick ripe fruits every 2–3 days; inspect for Botrytis grey mould (fluffy grey coating); remove infected fruits immediately.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Week A: Calcium Nitrate 3 g/L + K2SO4 4 g/L; Week B: 13:0:45 4 g/L + Humic Acid 2 ml/L.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip 1.5 hours daily; NEVER wet fruit or leaves in evenings – Botrytis thrives on wet surfaces.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest fruits with intact calyx (green cap) attached; cool in shade immediately; do not stack more than 2 crate layers high.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Sow 2 seeds per pit at 3×2 m spacing; thin to 1 plant/pit at 10 DAS; apply pre-emergence herbicide if weeds are a recurring issue.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Basal: FYM 20 t/ha + 8:16:8 NPK @ 150 kg/ha at sowing.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Pre-sowing irrigation; light irrigation at 5 DAS to break soil crust.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Direct sow – avoid transplanting squash as it does not tolerate root disturbance.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Train vines on wire trellis if growing vertically; hand pollinate female flowers at 08:00–10:00 using male flower pollen if bee activity is low.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Urea 25 kg/ha top-dress; Potassium Sulphate 30 kg/ha; Boron 1 g/L foliar for fruit set.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Furrow or drip every 3–4 days; target 25–30 mm/week during flowering.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Female flowers have a tiny fruit behind the petals; male flowers have only a thin stalk – pollinate female with fresh male pollen.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Harvest immature squash every 4–5 days for maximum continuous yield; leaving over-ripe fruits on vine halts new flowering.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: 0:0:50 SOP @ 3 g/L foliar to improve fruit firmness; no Urea at this stage.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Reduce irrigation slightly to firm up fruits and reduce powdery mildew risk.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Inspect all leaves for white powdery coating of Powdery Mildew; spray Sulphur 3 g/L or Trifloxystrobin at first appearance.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Annual cane pruning to 2-bud spurs; apply dormant spray (lime sulphur 5%) before bud burst to kill overwintering Downy Mildew spores.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Apply 20 t/ha FYM + 200 g/vine NPK 19:19:19 around drip zone just before bud burst.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: First post-pruning irrigation to break full dormancy; drip every 5–7 days.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Tie all canes to the trellis wire immediately after pruning to orient new growth uniformly.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Shoot thinning (retain 6–8 shoots per vine); remove any suckers from trunk; first Downy Mildew preventive spray.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Fertigation: 19:19:19 @ 5 g/vine/week + MgSO4 0.5% foliar; Zinc 0.3% foliar at 35 DAS.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip every 3–4 days; critical to keep soil moisture consistent during shoot growth.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Spray protective copper-based Downy Mildew fungicide (Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 2 g/L) at every 10-day interval.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Cluster thinning to 1–2 clusters/shoot for large berry size; dust Sulphur at 80% flowering for Powdery Mildew; never wet spray during full bloom.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: 0:52:34 (MKP) @ 2 g/L foliar at 10% and 80% flowering; Boron 1 g/L at 10% bloom.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Reduce irrigation slightly during full bloom to prevent berry shattering; resume normal after berry set.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Apply gibberellic acid (GA3 @ 25–50 ppm) at 50% bloom if seedless varieties are grown, to elongate berry and cluster.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Colour break (veraison) marks start of sugar accumulation; stop all N-containing fertilizers; remove dense leaves blocking sun on clusters.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Potassium Sulphate 300 g/vine via drip fertigate to maximise sugar (Brix) accumulation.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drastically reduce irrigation after veraison – stress improves sugar/acid balance; completely stop 10 days before harvest.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest when Brix ≥ 18 (table), ≥ 22 (wine/raisin); use sharp scissors to retain intact cluster.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Apply drought/stress to induce flower bud differentiation (Bahar treatment); completely withhold water for 40–60 days in dry season.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Apply 20 kg FYM + 200 g Urea + 200 g SSP + 100 g MOP per tree at start of stress cycle.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: COMPLETELY WITHHOLD – deliberate dry stress triggers the tree to shift from vegetative to reproductive mode.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Thin dense interior branches to allow light penetration for uniform flower bud setting on entire canopy.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Resume irrigation at bud break; spray Boron 1 g/L + Zinc 0.5 g/L at balloon stage of flowers; hand thin excess fruitlets if load is very high.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Boron 1 g/L + 0:52:34 @ 3 g/L foliar at petal fall for improved fruit set; K2SO4 via drip.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Resume drip immediately after flower bud swelling; maintain consistent moisture through fruit set.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Natural June-drop will remove 70–80% of fruitlets – this is normal; do not be alarmed.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Apply 2,4-D (4 ppm) spray at marble stage to reduce pre-harvest fruit drop; apply reflective mulch under canopy to improve colour.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Potassium Nitrate 13:0:45 @ 3 g/L foliar monthly; Calcium Nitrate 3 g/L for peel quality.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Steady drip every 4–5 days through fruit swell; reduce 15 days before harvest.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Spray Ethephon (39% SL @ 250 ppm) 30 days before target harvest date to advance and uniform fruit colouring.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Apply DNOC (Dinitro-ortho-cresol 0.5%) dormant spray; prune dead/crossing branches; apply Bordeaux mixture (8:8:100) before bud burst.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: FYM 30 kg/tree + 600 g Urea + 300 g SSP + 300 g MOP applied in soil around drip zone.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: First pre-bloom irrigation when soil starts thawing; drip at 5-day intervals.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Inspect every branch for Apple Scab overwintering lesions; Bordeaux spray is non-negotiable at silver-tip stage.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Release honey bee hives (8 hives/ha) for cross-pollination; avoid ALL insecticide sprays during bloom; remove frost-damaged open flowers daily.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Boron 0.3% foliar at pink bud stage; NO fertilizer during full bloom.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Light irrigation every 4–5 days; frost-protective night sprinklers if temperature forecasted below 0°C.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: This is the MOST CRITICAL window in apple production. Any mistake at bloom = 100% loss of that year's crop.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Chemical thinning: spray Carbaryl 1.5 g/L at petal fall + 10 days to reduce cluster; hand thin to 1 fruit/spur at 15 mm fruitlet size.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Urea 300 g/tree top dress; Calcium Chloride 0.4% foliar at 3-week intervals to prevent Bitter Pit.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip every 5–7 days; consistent moisture during cell division phase is critical for final fruit size.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Retain only the largest central fruitlet per cluster; rest should be manually removed by 60 DAS.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Apply Kaolin clay reflective spray at colour break; use Iodine starch test + starch pattern index to determine harvest maturity.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: No Nitrogen from 90 DAS; Potassium Sulphate 300 g/tree via drip for colour development.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Reduce to every 7–10 days; withhold completely 15 days before picking.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest when starch pattern index = 6–7 (scale of 8); use twist-and-lift motion to avoid breaking spurs.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Annual dormant pruning to open vase shape; apply Bordeaux paste on cut wounds; thin out crossing branches and old 3-year wood.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: FYM 25 kg/tree + 300 g Urea + 200 g SSP + 150 g MOP pre-bloom soil application.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: First pre-bloom irrigation; drip every 6–8 days.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Peach is a very precocious bearer – fruit set can be excessive; chemical thinning is usually needed.

crop_stage_rules.activity: No chemical sprays at full bloom; place honey bee hives; protect from late frost with smoke pots or overhead sprinklers.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Boron 0.3% foliar at pink bud stage for improved fruit set.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Light irrigation immediately after petal fall; avoid wetting ripening fruit.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Manual or chemical thinning to 15–20 cm fruit spacing on every branch by 30 DAS after petal fall.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Apply brown rot fungicide (Iprodione 2 g/L) 3 weeks before harvest; install bird-scare; harvest fruit at firm-ripe stage.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Potassium Sulphate 200 g/tree via drip for firmness and colour; no Nitrogen from pit hardening.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Keep soil evenly moist to prevent pit borer; withhold water 7 days before harvest.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest peaches in 2–3 passes as individual fruits mature at different rates on same tree.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Dormant pruning for open-centre structure; apply Bordeaux mixture to all wounds; remove blind wood (unproductive old spurs).
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: 25 kg FYM + 250 g Urea + 150 g SSP + 100 g MOP per tree.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: First pre-growth irrigation; drip every 7 days.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Cherry requires two or more compatible varieties for cross-pollination; verify orchard variety mix.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Deploy honey bee hives; NO sprays during bloom; frost protection is critical at this stage.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Boron 0.3% at balloon bud stage; no fertilizer during full bloom.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Light pre-bloom irrigation only; heavy irrigation during bloom causes pollen washing.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Cherry flowers for only 7–10 days; bee activity during this window determines entire year's crop.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Apply calcium sprays every 10 days to prevent fruit cracking; cover trees with anti-bird net and anti-rain cover 2 weeks before harvest.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Calcium Chloride 0.5% foliar every 10 days from fruitlet to harvest.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Maintain steady uniform drip; any sudden rainfall causes catastrophic fruit cracking – cover is essential.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Harvest cherries with stalk attached using scissors; chill immediately to 0–2°C to retain firmness.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Prepare acidic beds with sulphur amendment to achieve pH 4.5–5.5; plant 2-year rooted plugs; mulch 10 cm pine bark or sawdust.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Ammonium Sulphate (acid-forming N) 30 g/plant; NO Urea or other alkaline fertilizers.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip every day for 20 minutes in first month; reduce to alternate day once established; critical – blueberry is shallow-rooted.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Remove all flower buds in Year 1 – do not allow any fruit set; all energy must go to root establishment.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Introduce bumble bee hives; cross-pollination between varieties mandatory; thin excessive berries in Year 2 for larger berry size.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Ammonium Sulphate 50 g/plant; Sulphur 30 g/plant to maintain pH; no Phosphorus – blueberries have low P requirement.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip daily; maintain soil moisture at 70% field capacity; mulch layer MUST be kept intact to conserve moisture.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Pick berries when they turn deep blue-black and detach with gentle roll – wait 3–4 days after colour for full sweetness.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Plant dormant canes 45 cm apart in rows 2.5 m wide; install T-bar trellis with 3 horizontal wires; mulch 8 cm straw around base.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: FYM 30 t/ha + NPK 10:26:26 @ 200 kg/ha at planting time.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip every 2–3 days; shallow roots require frequent light irrigation rather than heavy deep watering.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Cut all canes to 25 cm after planting to encourage vigorous new primocane growth from root crown.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Tie new primocanes to trellis as they grow; remove any diseased floricanes immediately; harvest begins on floricanes in Year 2.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: Fertigation: 19:19:19 @ 3 kg/acre monthly; Calcium Nitrate 2 g/L foliar for cane strength.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Drip every 2 days; avoid overhead watering – cane blight thrives in wet conditions.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: After fruiting, cut floricanes (2-year old) to ground level; RETAIN all current-year primocanes for next season's harvest.

crop_stage_rules.activity: Pick raspberries every 2 days at full red colour; handle gently – drupelets detach easily causing bruising.
crop_stage_rules.fertilizer: 0:0:50 SOP @ 3 g/L for fruit firmness and storage; no N at fruiting stage.
crop_stage_rules.irrigation: Maintain drip every 2 days; consistent moisture critical – drought causes small seedy fruits.
crop_stage_rules.standard_action: Chill harvested raspberries within 2 hours to 0–2°C; shelf life is only 2–4 days even under refrigeration.

weather_rules.action: POSTPONE all foliar fertilizer sprays and pesticide applications. Rain washes active ingredients before absorption and causes chemical runoff.
weather_rules.irrigation_directive: SUSPEND scheduled irrigation – rain will supply sufficient moisture. Check field bunds to prevent waterlogging.
weather_rules.protective_measure: Clear drainage channels and ensure water can exit the field freely within 30 minutes of heavy downpour.
weather_rules.reschedule_guidance: Reschedule sprays within 24 hrs after rain, once leaf surface is dry.

weather_rules.action: Increase irrigation frequency. Apply organic mulch (paddy straw 5 cm) around root zone to conserve moisture and lower soil temperature.
weather_rules.irrigation_directive: PROVIDE light, frequent drip/micro-sprinkler irrigation in early morning (05:00–07:00) and late evening (19:00–21:00) to minimise evapotranspiration loss.
weather_rules.protective_measure: Apply anti-transpirant / Kaolin clay spray (2%) on fruit canopy to reduce sun-scorch and excessive transpiration.
weather_rules.reschedule_guidance: Avoid heavy dose chemical sprays during peak daytime heat; reschedule to evening.

weather_rules.action: CONDITIONS IDEAL FOR FUNGAL SPORE GERMINATION. Apply preventive bio-fungicide (Trichoderma @ 5 g/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L) before humidity exceeds 85% consistently.
weather_rules.irrigation_directive: SWITCH ENTIRELY TO DRIP – avoid all overhead sprinklers to keep leaf surface dry and reduce free moisture on canopy.
weather_rules.protective_measure: Increase plant row spacing air-flow. Prune dense lower foliage for better ventilation. Remove affected leaves and destroy.
weather_rules.reschedule_guidance: Spray fungicide in early morning so it dries before night humidity peaks.

weather_rules.action: Protect sensitive crops and nursery beds. Light evening sprinkler irrigation releases latent heat of fusion (~80 cal/g) as water freezes, keeping leaf temp above 0°C.
weather_rules.irrigation_directive: Run light overhead sprinklers overnight across orchards and tender vegetable crops. Do NOT use drip – surface thermal protection requires overhead spray.
weather_rules.protective_measure: Cover nursery beds and young transplants with agro-film / straw mulch blanket. Apply straw smoke in border areas if temperature drops below 2°C.
weather_rules.reschedule_guidance: Resume normal activities once temperature rises above 5°C in the morning.

weather_rules.action: STOP all synthetic chemical spraying to honour Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI). Clean and sanitise harvesting crates, storage containers and transport vehicles.
weather_rules.irrigation_directive: WITHHOLD irrigation 3–7 days before scheduled harvest to improve fruit sugar concentration, firmness and post-harvest shelf life.
weather_rules.protective_measure: Harvest during early morning (05:00–09:00) when ambient temperature is lowest. Avoid mechanical bruising; use padded crates.
weather_rules.reschedule_guidance: Resume fertilizer and irrigation only after all harvesting is complete for that flush.
